A map of Nigeria in 1967 showing the borders of the newly created 12 states. The Northern region is divided into 6 states (North-Western, North-Central, Kano, North-Eastern, Benue-Plateau, Kwara). The South has 6 states (Western, Lagos, Mid-Western, East-Central, South-Eastern, Rivers). Each state is clearly labeled. Clean flat textbook illustration, distinct pastel colours for each state, white background.
